The spec, the ADR for trusted repairs, the artifact list, the trace and the fragment match the script, workflow and tests. The known gap, that the first real repair needs the workflow on the default branch, is recorded.

A repair writes one non-forced child commit holding only the manifest, an unchanged manifest is a no-op, CI is dispatched explicitly because token pushes do not trigger it, and a concurrent branch change rejects the write.
Covered by the registered checks that passed in the full strict matrix; this scope adds its own check dependabot-runtime-repair-integration.
Attributed paths are the repair script, its test, the repair workflow, the CI edit, the contract test, the ADR and the fragment, with no finding from artifact-check or surface-check.

The job never checks out or runs pull request code, accepts only full SHA pins and version comments plus the derived manifest, and only the repair job receives write permission. The first live run on a real Dependabot pull request has not happened yet.
